::: {.obsidian-disciplinary-notice}
:::

State the purpose of the notice. Name the allegations the meeting
will consider and the policy that applies.

# The allegations

Set out the allegations in detail. Give the dates, the evidence,
and the witnesses.

# The meeting

State the date, time and location of the meeting. Name the chair
and the right of the employee to bring a companion.

# The right to bring a companion

State the right of the employee to bring a companion and the role
the companion plays.

# Possible outcomes

State the range of outcomes the chair may decide. Name the right
of appeal.
